services.desc: Train to teach at the New Gold Standard of Pilates and explore teaching opportunities as Pilates Addiction grows. Whether you’re here to train as a Pilates educator, teach at a Pilates Addiction studio, or do both - this is where it starts. Pilates Addiction is built for people who want to teach Pilates with intention, whether you’re beginning your journey through educator training or looking to bring your experience into a Pilates Addiction studio. Our training goes deeper: understanding the body from the inside out, exploring the intelligence behind movement, and learning how to lead others with clarity and confidence. blurb: Pilates Addiction was created for people who want more from Pilates, more strength, more focus, and more reason to keep showing up.Some Pilates becomes too basic over time. Other studios swing the opposite direction, turning Pilates into something loud, chaotic, or bootcamp-like.
